statusDefinitions.PAIRABLE_EDGE: Both G2A(right) and H2(left,right) are present; the mutually exclusive outcome is CONFLICT or NON_CONFLICT.
statusDefinitions.UNPAIRED_NO_G2A_RIGHT: H2 may be present but there is no G2A decision for right; not eligible for conflict classification.
statusDefinitions.UNPAIRED_NO_H2: G2A(right) exists but no H2 decision is present for the edge.
statusDefinitions.NON_CONFLICT: PAIRABLE_EDGE that does not meet conflict predicate.

denominator.conflictRate: NOT_QUALIFICATION_VALID: no document has full-pack G2A and H2 ledgers
